android.desc:
Stop letting your saved reels, recipes, and tutorials gather digital dust. 

Every week, you save dozens of insightful Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, coding tips, and workout routines. But when do you ever revisit them? Social media apps are designed for endless doom-scrolling, not retention—turning your saved bookmarks into a graveyard of forgotten ideas.

Minsnap transforms your chaotic bookmarks into an interactive 3D knowledge deck powered by Gemini AI and smart spaced repetition. Turn passive video consumption into lasting active recall.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚡ 1-TAP ZERO-FRICTION CAPTURE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Native Android Share Target: Save directly from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X (Twitter), or Chrome via Android's system share sheet without opening Minsnap.
• Seamless Instagram Reel Connection: Link your Instagram account once in Settings for seamless reel ingestion—capturing full captions, audio transcripts, and pinned comments without hitting login walls.
• Clean URL Parser: Automatically strips tracking parameters, fetching clean thumbnails, video durations, and titles.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧠 GEMINI AI TAKEAWAY EXTRACTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Substance-Over-Wrapper: Our AI engine strips away clickbait, engagement hooks, and promotional filler, extracting only the actual substance taught or demonstrated.
• Actionable Bullet Points: Synthesizes complex reels and long-form tutorials into 3–5 sharp, step-by-step takeaways.
• Smart Categorization: Automatically detects the domain and assigns relevant tags (#Cooking, #Tech, #Finance, #Fitness, #Design).

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎴 3D INTERACTIVE FLASHCARD DECK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Flippable 3D Cards: Tap to flip between the visual media preview on the front and rich AI key takeaways on the back.
• Tactile Card Stack: Swipe left/right through your personalized knowledge deck with satisfying haptic feedback and micro-sound FX.
• 1-Tap Source Deep-Link: Jump directly back to the original reel or video anytime you need the full original context.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏰ SPACED REPETITION & AUDIBLE RECALL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Defeat the Forgetting Curve: Reinforce what you learn right when memory retention begins to fade.
• Smart Recall Presets: Set reminders in 1 tap (+4 Hours, Tomorrow 9 AM, In 3 Days, or Custom Date & Time).
